xmldoc.short_description: Numerical linearization of an nflow model.

syntax.syntax_item: [A, B, C, D] = linmod(model, x0, u0)

param_input_item.param_description: a loaded system (name or handle) or the path to a .nflow file.
optional operating-point state (length nx). Absent: the post-INIT state.
optional operating-point inputs (length nu). Absent: zero.

param_output_item.param_description: the nx-by-nx state Jacobian d(xdot)/dx about the operating point.
the nx-by-nu input Jacobian d(xdot)/du about the operating point.
the ny-by-nx output Jacobian dy/dx about the operating point.
the ny-by-nu feedthrough Jacobian dy/du about the operating point.

description.p: linmod returns the continuous-time state-space linearization of model about its post-INIT operating point.

The Jacobians are obtained by central finite differences of the same global right-hand side the ode4 / variable-step solver assembles: the continuous state x gathers every continuous block's state, the inputs u are the external-port Label Source blocks (isExternalPort), xdot = f(x, u) is the graph's derivative, and y the model's Label Sink outputs. A linear model linearizes to itself.
An input that should participate in B / D must be an external-port Label Source; a plain Label Source used for internal goto/from routing is not a model input.

Both top-level (flat) models and continuous states nested inside subsystems are supported: a nested state's coupling to the external inputs (B) and to the outputs across the subsystem boundary (C) is captured.
